title: Valneva Announces Successful Outcome of its Annual General Meeting
summary: Lyon (France), June 25, 2026 – Valneva SE (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company (“the Company”), today announced that shareholders approved all resolutions recommended by the Board of Directors at the Company’s Annual General Meeting (AGM), held earlier today in Lyon, France. To access the full release, please click on the PDF below.
body_markdown:
Lyon (France), June 25, 2026 – Valneva SE (Nasdaq: VALN; Euronext Paris: VLA), a specialty vaccine company (“the Company”), today announced that


shareholders approved all resolutions recommended by the Board of Directors at the Company’s Annual General Meeting (AGM), held earlier today in Lyon, France.


To access the full release, please click on the PDF below.
